name: Retrieve the actual builder subject for fresh canonical tests
Set up the existing pinned Node runtime
Install the actual builder's exact locked dependencies
Run fresh canonical correctness on the actual builder subject
Retrieve genuine direct-child evidence and source history
Select the reviewed source, without copying evidence into it
run:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(git show -s --format=%P "$REVIEW_EVIDENCE")" = "$REVIEWED_SOURCE"
git checkout --detach "$REVIEWED_SOURCE"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$REVIEWED_SOURCE"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD^{tree})" = "$REVIEWED_TREE"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD:web)" = "$REVIEWED_WEB_TREE"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all)"

name: Verify original review binding and record distinct builder identity
Install the exact locked build dependencies
Verify source calculations, packaging, types and lint
run:
node web/scripts/sync-official-authority.mjs --check
npm run test:tw-entry-plan
node --test scripts/package-standalone-release.test.mjs
npm --prefix web run typecheck
npm --prefix web run lint
git diff --exit-code

name: Verify source fixture navigation separately from packaged production
run:
cd web
npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
npx playwright test --config playwright.trade-plan.config.ts

name: Build production after the separate development fixture server has stopped
Package and verify the approved source, not the merge or builder commit
run:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$REVIEWED_SOURCE"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)"
destination="$RUNNER_TEMP/reviewed-standalone"
export_dir="$RUNNER_TEMP/standalone-export"
mkdir -m 0700 "$destination"
node scripts/package-standalone-release.mjs "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" "$destination" "$REVIEWED_SOURCE" "$REVIEWED_SOURCE" > "$export_dir/package.json"
node scripts/verify-standalone-release.mjs "$destination/$REVIEWED_SOURCE" > "$export_dir/verification.json"
cp "$destination/$REVIEWED_SOURCE/release-manifest.json" "$export_dir/release-manifest.json"
git rev-parse HEAD HEAD^{tree} HEAD:web > "$export_dir/source-identity.txt"

name: Boot the packaged production entrypoint without credentials
Seal the downloadable binary and receipts
run:
set -euo pipefail
export_dir="$RUNNER_TEMP/standalone-export"
tar -czf "$export_dir/stockinsider-linux.tar.gz" -C "$RUNNER_TEMP/reviewed-standalone" "$REVIEWED_SOURCE"
(cd "$export_dir" && sha256sum stockinsider-linux.tar.gz release-manifest.json package.json verification.json source-identity.txt review-binding.json builder-canonical.log builder-canonical.tap builder-correctness.json packaged-boot.json packaged-boot.stdout packaged-boot.stderr > SHA256SUMS)
